seoTitle: Tournament Bracket Generator: Single Elimination and Round Robin
metaDescription: Build a single-elimination bracket with byes and standard seeding, or a round-robin schedule, from a list of players or teams. Printable output.
intro: Set up a knockout bracket or a league schedule from your list of teams.
why:
For single elimination the bracket is padded to the next power of two, seeds are placed in the standard order (1 plays the lowest seed, 2 the second lowest, and so on) and byes go to the top seeds. Round robin uses the circle method so every pair meets exactly once and nobody plays twice in a round; with an odd number one player rests each round. You can shuffle the seeds first. Properties were verified with automated checks.

The output is a list of matches and a printable page; double elimination and result tracking are not included.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter the teams in seed order, one per line.
Choose single elimination or round robin.
Print the page or copy the matches.

faq.a: To the highest seeds, so they skip the first round.
Single elimination has players minus one; round robin has n(n-1)/2.
